Daylight fills this stylized post-apocalyptic scene, revealing a supermarket beyond an open forecourt. The shop appears as a roofless cutaway: a shop floor enclosed by walls, broken windows across the front, and an entrance facing the forecourt. Inside, two parallel rows of retail shelves frame a broad central aisle that connects the entrance to the rear of the shop. Checkout counters stand just inside the entrance, while beverage coolers and frozen-goods freezers line the rear wall. Some shelves stand bare. On the other shelves sits a sparse assortment of groceries: cans, milk bottles, pasta boxes, and food packages. Metal storage racks and stacked boxes occupy one rear corner. Abandoned shopping carts cluster near the entrance. A large market sign is mounted above the entrance. A freestanding market sign stands in the forecourt. Parking stops and traffic cones trace the forecourt edges. Small garbage piles, a trash bin, and discarded tires occupy the outer perimeter; grass and small trees grow along the outer edges of the site. Worn surfaces and muted colors characterize the scene. The shop is abandoned, the daylight is clear, and circulation routes remain open.
